## Last-checked: 2026-09-22

# KnowledgeDigest

KnowledgeDigest is a local-first Python tool for indexing documents into a portable SQLite/FTS5 knowledge database. It supports sentence-bounded semantic chunking (~350 words), full-text search with BM25 ranking, optional LLM summaries (Gemini Flash / Claude Haiku), a PySide6 desktop GUI, a stdlib web viewer, CLI commands, and a Python API.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/knowledgedigest
Parent Organization: https://github.com/file-bricks
Umbrella Ecosystem: https://github.com/open-bricks
Author: Lukas Geiger (https://github.com/lukisch)
License: MIT License (https://github.com/file-bricks/knowledgedigest/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Useful Entry Points

- `README.md`: user-facing overview, 18-point dual-anchor navigation, installation, commands, and feature summary.
- `README_de.md`: German documentation with reciprocal 18-point navigation parity.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: module map, data flow, schema overview, and design decisions.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: Level 1 SBOM inventory, runtime invariants (INV-LOCAL-01..INV-SLA-10), RunAsInvoker unprivileged execution, and Zero-Copyleft isolation guarantee.
- `SECURITY.md`: local-first invariants, vulnerability reporting, and 48-hour response SLA.
- `digest.py`: high-level API and CLI command implementation.
- `web_viewer.py`: local browser viewer without external web framework dependencies (`http://localhost:8787`).
- `gui/`: PySide6 desktop interface with dark theme and 3-panel layout.
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: automated contract tests for PEP 621, SBOM invariants, and documentation parity.
- `tests/test_no_agpl.py`: contract test enforcing zero-copyleft and prohibiting AGPL libraries (Decision E08).

## Run And Test

```bash
python -m pip install -e .
python -m pytest
python -m KnowledgeDigest status
```

Runtime data is local and ignored by Git: `data/`, `*.db`, and `knowledgedigest.json`.

## Governance & Runtime Invariants

- `INV-LOCAL-01`: Local-First & Zero Egress (all document parsing and SQLite queries run locally).
- `INV-SQLITE-02`: ACID SQLite FTS5 Full-Text Search Engine with BM25 snippet ranking.
- `INV-CHUNK-03`: Sentence-Bounded Semantic Chunking (~350 words, preserving grammatical clauses).
- `INV-COPYLEFT-04`: Zero-Copyleft MIT Guarantee (`pypdfium2` over PyMuPDF, dynamically linked PySide6).
- `INV-RUNAS-05`: Unprivileged User Mode (`RunAsInvoker`, no administrative elevation required).
- `INV-DUAL-06`: Dual Frontends (PySide6 Native Desktop GUI + Stdlib Web Viewer on localhost:8787).
- `INV-OPTLLM-07`: Optional Asynchronous LLM Integration (fully operational offline without LLM).
- `INV-DEDUPE-08`: Cryptographic SHA-256 Deduplication with non-destructive `_Papierkorb` quarantine.
- `INV-DOCS-09`: 100% Bilingual Documentation Parity (18-point reciprocal dual HTML anchors).
- `INV-SLA-10`: Statutory Disclaimer (§ 521 BGB Gefälligkeitsrecht) & 48-hour security response SLA.

## Audience

- **Local-first users** who want a portable, self-contained document knowledge base without cloud dependencies
- **Python developers** building document-indexing, retrieval, or LLM-preprocessing pipelines
- **AI engineers** needing an offline, privacy-preserving search backend for local LLM workflows
- **Researchers and writers** managing large collections of PDFs, Markdown, DOCX, and text files
- **Privacy-conscious teams** who need FTS5 full-text search without any data leaving the local machine
